title_sq: Apartament ne shitje 2+1+2+ parkim Don Bosko
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1+2+post parkimi ne Don Bosko. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 2 banim te nje objekti me ashensor dhe organizohet nga nje sallon i madh qe ka dhe kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi dhe dy tualete. Gjithashtu ka dhe nje ballkon te madh qe lidh sallonin me nje nga dhomat e gjumit. Ne cmim eshte i perfshire edhe nje post parkimi.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Apartamenti disponon dhe nje post parkimi me cmim 25.000Euro.
Per me shume informacion ose per nje vizite ne prone jeni te lutur te na kontaktoni.
title_en: Apartment for sale 2+1+2+ parking Don Bosko
description_en: 2+1+2+parking post apartment for sale in Don Bosco. The apartment is located on the 2nd residential floor of a building with an elevator and is organized by a large living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms and two bathrooms. There is also a large balcony that connects the living room with one of the bedrooms. A parking post is also included in the price. Has regular mortgage documentation. The apartment also has a parking post with a price of 25,000 Euros. For more information or for a visit to the property, please contact us.
